# Germans Savcisens

> Computational Social Scientist at Northeastern University (Network Science Institute). Research focuses on the stability of beliefs and knowledge in Large Language Models, and on modeling human lives as sequences (life2vec).

PhD, Computational Social Science. Postdoctoral Research Associate, Northeastern University.

## Key sections

- [Publications](https://savcisens.com/publications/): Peer-reviewed papers and preprints, including life2vec, tab2seq, and related work.
- [Blog](https://savcisens.com/blog/): Longer-form writing on research and methods, including a life2vec explainer.
- [Talks](https://savcisens.com/talks/): Invited talks, conference presentations, and seminars.
- [Teaching](https://savcisens.com/teaching/): Courses taught and reviewing activity.
- [Now](https://savcisens.com/now/): Current activities and updates.
- [Contact](https://savcisens.com/contact/): How to get in touch.
